name: ECFMG Certification and Pathways
description: Certification process for international medical graduates to enter US GME via the NRMP Match.

facts.value: Pass USMLE Step 1 and Step 2 CK
Satisfy clinical and communication skills requirement via one of the ECFMG Pathways (1-6) plus OET Medicine
Medical school must be listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools with ECFMG sponsor note; from 2024 schools must be accredited by a WFME-recognized agency
Primary-source verification of final medical diploma and transcript via EPIC/ECFMG

topics.name: Pathways 1-6 for clinical and communication skills

children.name: Pathway 1: licensed to practice in another country
Pathway 2: OSCE from an acceptable medical school
Pathway 3: school accredited by agency recognized by WFME
Pathway 4: school accredited by agency with WFME recognition policy
Pathway 5: school issues degree jointly with US school
Pathway 6: evaluation of clinical patient encounters by licensed physicians
